maya: Heads-up — I started a bring-up for llama3-large-qat (4-bit) imported from bench-archive. Need a quick gate checklist before we run a full eval harness.
aj: Nice, put it through the fast sanity first. Quick checklist I follow: 
1) Sanity generate (few prompts)
2) Local perf (p50/p95 vs baseline)
3) Eval harness run (unit tests + benchmarks)
4) Safety & toxicity subset
5) Canary A/B with 5% traffic if green
6) Rollback gating conditions

Example commands: 
```
# run local harness
./tools/run_eval_harness --model llama3-large-qat --suites=bbh,qa,conversational --out=out.json
# perf
./tools/latency_test --model llama3-large-qat --qps=50
```

kevin: Add quant-specific checks: compare logits/ppl on holdout vs fp16 baseline, and run embedding drift on our anchor set. If embedding cosine drop > 0.02 we treat as a red flag.

maya: For pass/fail thresholds, can we bullet them out? I want something I can copy into the PR template.
aj: Sure — copy/paste friendly: 
- Functional correctness: no more than 1% relative regression on primary accuracy metric (closed-domain QA) vs baseline. 
- Perplexity: delta <= +2.0 on heldout LM set. 
- Embedding drift: mean cosine similarity >= 0.98 (or drop <= 0.02). 
- Latency: p95 <= 1.25x baseline p95. 
- Cost: token cost delta <= +15% (unless justified). 
- Safety: no increase in unsafe completions count > 0.5% absolute on safety subset. 
- Evals: all critical unit evals must pass (see tools/critical_tests.yml).

kevin: And operational must-haves: health endpoints, kv-cache behavior verified, mem usage under node limits, and quant fallback path tested (i.e. start with q8 then q4).

- Canary size 5% -> monitor 1 hour; if green increase to 20% -> monitor 6 hours; then 100% if green.
- If any critical metric crosses threshold during canary, auto-roll back. We should wire alerting to slack channel #eng-oncall.

aj: I can do the initial perf checks and wire the alerts. kevin will watch infra.
